nodes.description: Immutable address of DssExecLib contract used as delegatecall target in DssAction.
Immutable bool controlling whether execute is restricted to office hours.
Constant Changelog address used for system address lookups.
Immutable PauseAbstract pause contract used for scheduling and casting spells.
Immutable address of the spell action contract.
Public timestamp when the spell becomes executable.
Public boolean flag preventing double-casting of the spell.
Immutable timestamp after which the spell cannot be scheduled.
External entrypoint in DssAction that runs actions subject to the limited modifier.
Virtual public function in DssAction overridden by spell-specific actions.
Internal function that delegatecalls into the immutable lib contract with arbitrary data.
Public function that schedules the spell after checking expiration and setting eta.
Public function that casts the scheduled spell once.
DssSpellAction actions implementation performing collateral onboarding and changelog updates.
External view function computing the next allowed cast time based on office hours.
External view function exposing whether office hours are enabled on the action contract.
block.timestamp used for office-hour checks, scheduling, and next cast time calculation.
Delegatecall to the lib contract, executing external code in the context of the spell.
External call to pause.plot during schedule.
External call to pause.exec during cast.
External call to ChainlogAbstract_2(LOG).removeAddress to remove FAUCET.
External calls to LPOracle.orb0() and orb1() to obtain medianizer addresses.
bytes memory data parameter of libcall, passed to lib.delegatecall.
bytes32 key parameter used when updating changelog addresses.
address value parameter used when updating changelog addresses.
Local castTime variable in nextCastTime.
Local day variable computed from castTime in nextCastTime.
Local hour variable computed from castTime in nextCastTime.
Local minute variable computed from castTime in nextCastTime.
Local second variable computed from castTime in nextCastTime.
CollateralOpts memory co parameter used by addNewCollateral.

edges.reason: block.timestamp is used inside the limited modifier to gate execute on weekday and office hours.
schedule uses block.timestamp (now) for expiration check and eta assignment.
nextCastTime uses block.timestamp to compute the allowed cast time.
officeHours state variable controls whether execute is subject to timestamp-based office hours.
execute calls the virtual actions function.
actions call internal helper functions that route through libcall.
libcall performs a delegatecall to lib, which can execute external code and reenter.
lib state variable is the target of the delegatecall in libcall.
DssSpellAction.actions invokes DssAction helpers that use libcall.
DssSpellAction.actions calls removeAddress on the Chainlog contract.
DssSpellAction.actions calls orb0/orb1 on the LPOracle contract.
schedule calls pause.plot externally.
cast calls pause.exec externally after setting done to true.
schedule reads and writes eta.
cast reads and writes done to prevent re-casting.
schedule checks expiration before scheduling.
data parameter is passed into lib.delegatecall inside libcall.
key parameter flows through setChangelogAddress into libcall.
value parameter flows through setChangelogAddress into libcall.
castTime local variable is computed and used in nextCastTime.
day local variable is computed from castTime in nextCastTime.
hour local variable is computed from castTime in nextCastTime.
minute local variable is computed from castTime in nextCastTime.
second local variable is computed from castTime in nextCastTime.
co parameter is built in actions and passed to addNewCollateral.

normalization_plan.reason: data is only used as the calldata for libcall's delegatecall.
key is used in setChangelogAddress which wraps libcall.
value is used in setChangelogAddress which wraps libcall.
castTime is a local variable computed and consumed entirely within nextCastTime.
day is a local variable computed from castTime in nextCastTime.
hour is a local variable computed from castTime in nextCastTime.
minute is a local variable computed from castTime in nextCastTime.
second is a local variable computed from castTime in nextCastTime.
co is created in DssSpellAction.actions and passed to addNewCollateral.
